name: Graciela Hierro
shortBio: Mexican moral philosopher who pioneered institutional feminist philosophy in Mexico, developing an ethics of female autonomy, joy, and self-determination.
centralQuestion: How can moral philosophy replace self-sacrificial patriarchal norms with a feminist ethics of pleasure, autonomy, and mutual care?

keyWorks.title: Ética y feminismo (Ethics and Feminism)
keyWorks.description: Systematic Mexican feminist ethics redefining moral agency and women’s right to self-affirmation.

keyWorks.title: La ética del placer
keyWorks.description: Articulates a feminist philosophy of embodied joy and autonomy beyond ascetic moralism.
